title.en: Harry’s limited fan reading
title.zh: 哈利的有限同人读法

paragraphs.en: Harry is the central Hogwarts student whose adventures give the series its name. This edition selects a narrow, ordinary angle: trying a workable first step when a harmless shared activity is waiting to begin. It does not measure heroism, courage, leadership or how you would respond to danger. A paper-game choice cannot give you Harry’s biography, magical abilities or responsibility for a whole group.
paragraphs.zh: 哈利是系列同名主角，在霍格沃茨的冒险构成故事。本版只选一个普通窄角度：无害共同活动等着开始时，先试能行的一步。不测英雄气概、勇气、领导力或面对危险的反应。纸上游戏选择无法给你哈利的生平、魔力或对整个群体的责任。

title.en: The first clue on a paper map
title.zh: 纸地图上的第一个线索

paragraphs.en: Friends have invented an imaginary-school treasure hunt. Everyone has ideas about the route, but nobody has tested the first clue. You take a simple turn and let the others respond to what happens. Beginning gives the group something concrete to discuss. It is still reasonable to ask for an explanation, choose a different role or stop if the activity is no longer enjoyable.
paragraphs.zh: 朋友设计了想象学校纸上寻宝，路线想法很多，却没人试第一个线索。你走个简单步骤，让大家根据实际情况回应。开始带来可讨论的具体东西；仍可请人解释、改选分工，不好玩也可停。

title.en: A first turn beside six other contributions
title.zh: 第一步与另外六种贡献

paragraphs.en: Hermione checks the reference, Ron makes the game feel shared and Ginny chooses a part for herself. Neville offers a manageable way in, Luna considers an unusual possibility and Hagrid welcomes people and their practical needs. Harry’s selected angle gets a safe trial moving. None of these contributions is more heroic or morally valuable, and a tied guide is not a hidden identity.
paragraphs.zh: 赫敏核参考，罗恩让游戏有共同感，金妮自选角色；纳威给可做的入口，卢娜考虑不寻常可能，海格迎接人和实际需要。哈利角度让安全试玩动起来。贡献不分谁更英雄、道德更高，并列说明也不是隐藏身份。

title.en: Starting does not require taking over
title.zh: 开始不需要接管

paragraphs.en: A first move is useful when other people still have a real chance to shape the activity. Explain what you are trying and invite the next contribution instead of turning a trial into a decision for everyone. You can also wait when information is missing. A high count cannot establish impulsivity, confidence or bravery, and a lower count does not mean that you lack initiative.
paragraphs.zh: 第一步好用的条件，是别人仍有真实塑造活动的机会。说清在试什么，邀请下一项贡献，不把试玩变成替所有人决定。信息不足也可等。高计数不确立冲动、自信或勇敢，低计数不表示没主动性。

title.en: Try an explicitly provisional first step
title.zh: 试一个明确暂定的第一步

paragraphs.en: For one small paper game or hobby plan, offer a first action that is easy to revise. Say it is a trial and ask what the group notices afterwards. Compare what became clearer with what still needs discussion. The experiment is about getting useful feedback from a safe beginning, not proving that you are a hero or should take bigger risks.
paragraphs.zh: 一次纸上游戏或兴趣计划，提一个容易修改的初步行动。说是试玩，之后问大家看见什么，再比较哪些清楚了、哪些仍需讨论。这是在安全开始中取反馈，不证明英雄身份，也不要求冒更大风险。

title.en: Hermione’s limited fan reading
title.zh: 赫敏的有限同人读法

paragraphs.en: Hermione is one of Harry’s close friends at Hogwarts, with reading and study prominent in her story. This edition selects the appeal of checking a reference before using a claim. It does not test intelligence, grades, diligence or academic potential. A count from fictional hobby choices cannot place you in Ravenclaw, Gryffindor or any other house, and it does not establish that your interpretation is always right.
paragraphs.zh: 赫敏是哈利在霍格沃茨的亲密朋友，阅读与学习在故事里很突出。本版只选引用主张前先查参考的兴趣，不测智力、成绩、勤奋或学业潜力。虚构兴趣选择的次数不能把你放进任何学院，也不确立解释总正确。

title.en: Two confident explanations of an object
title.zh: 物件的两种肯定解释

paragraphs.en: A fan booklet gives two confident explanations of an invented magical object. You look for the passage each relies on and mark where the text ends and the fan addition begins. The aim is clarity, not banning imaginative additions. The group can choose an invented version for its game while being honest that it is a new idea rather than something the original story established.
paragraphs.zh: 同人册子对一个虚构魔法物件给出两种肯定解释。你找各自依据，标出原文到哪里、同人添写从哪里开始。目的是清楚，不是禁止想象。小组可选虚构版本玩，只需如实说明是新点子，不冒充原作已确立。

title.en: A reference beside six other contributions
title.zh: 参考与另外六种贡献

paragraphs.en: Harry starts a trial, Ron offers easy company and Ginny names her own chosen part. Neville makes the first attempt manageable, Luna supplies an unusual possibility and Hagrid considers the welcome. Hermione’s selected angle distinguishes a source from an addition. These can coexist in one fan activity without ranking intelligence, imagination or whose enjoyment deserves to count.
paragraphs.zh: 哈利开始试玩，罗恩轻松陪伴，金妮说自己的选定部分；纳威让初次尝试做得来，卢娜添意外可能，海格关心欢迎。赫敏角度区分来源与添写。可共存于同一活动，不评智力、想象或谁的乐趣才算数。

title.en: Enough checking for this occasion
title.zh: 核查到适合这次的程度

paragraphs.en: A casual game does not need an exhaustive research project unless the group actually wants one. Choose which detail matters to the agreement and leave unrelated questions for later. If a source is unclear, say so rather than invent certainty. A high count does not prove perfectionism or superior knowledge, and a lower count is not evidence of carelessness or lower intelligence.
paragraphs.zh: 轻松游戏不必变成穷尽研究，除非大家真想这样做。挑与约定有关的细节，其他问题以后再看。来源不清就说不清，不造肯定。高计数不证明完美主义或知识更高，低计数不说明粗心或智力较低。

title.en: Try separating source and invention
title.zh: 试着区分来源与虚构添写

paragraphs.en: In one short fan note, label one detail supported by the original and one idea you have added. Let a reader check whether the distinction is clear. Afterwards, notice whether this helped discussion without closing off play. The exercise concerns transparent writing, not a test of literary expertise, school ability or how much information you must collect before joining in.
paragraphs.zh: 一张短同人笔记，标一处原作有支持的细节和一个自己添的想法。请读者看区别是否清楚，再留意是否既有助讨论又没关住游戏。这是在试透明写法，不测文学专长、学业，也不规定参加前必须搜多少资料。

title.en: Ron’s limited fan reading
title.zh: 罗恩的有限同人读法

paragraphs.en: Ron is one of Harry’s close Hogwarts friends and Ginny’s brother. This edition independently selects an everyday angle of companionship and a shared sense of fun. It does not reduce his whole story to comic relief or assess your loyalty, humour or social ability. You do not need a particular family, appearance or role in a friendship to recognise the appeal of spending an ordinary hour together.
paragraphs.zh: 罗恩是哈利在霍格沃茨的亲密朋友，也是金妮的哥哥。本版独立选日常陪伴、共同乐趣这个角度，不把全部故事缩成搞笑担当，也不评忠诚、幽默或社交能力。不需特定家庭、外貌或友情角色，也能喜欢一起过普通一小时。

title.en: The wait before a train-themed game
title.zh: 火车桌游开始前的等待

paragraphs.en: A train-themed game cannot start until the last friends arrive. You enjoy an easy conversation, share a small joke and make the pause feel like part of being together. There is no need to invent an impressive activity for every spare minute. Others can quietly read or step away; the shared moment works when companionship is offered rather than required.
paragraphs.zh: 火车主题游戏要等最后几位朋友到，你轻松聊聊、分享小笑话，让等待也成为相聚一部分。每个空闲分钟不必都安排得厉害。别人可安静读、可离开一会；陪伴是邀请而非要求时，共同时刻才好用。

title.en: Company beside six other contributions
title.zh: 陪伴与另外六种贡献

paragraphs.en: Harry takes a first turn, Hermione checks the reference and Ginny chooses her own role. Neville offers a smaller entry, Luna follows curiosity and Hagrid looks after practical welcome. Ron’s selected angle keeps the ordinary experience shared. Different contributions can support one game without ranking friendship, warmth or popularity, and an equal count does not place someone permanently in a supporting role.
paragraphs.zh: 哈利走第一步，赫敏核参考，金妮选角色；纳威给小入口，卢娜跟好奇，海格照顾实际欢迎。罗恩角度保留普通体验的共同感。不同贡献可支持同一游戏，不给友情、温暖或人气排级，并列也不让人永久当配角。

title.en: Leave room for different kinds of company
title.zh: 给不同陪伴方式留位置

paragraphs.en: Someone may enjoy being present without joking or talking much. You can share space without making them explain their mood, and you may want a quiet hour yourself. Ask what kind of company is welcome. A high count cannot establish extroversion, insecurity or a need for approval, and a lower count does not mean you are a less dependable friend.
paragraphs.zh: 有人喜欢在场，却不想开玩笑或多说话。可共处，不要求解释心情；自己也可能想安静一小时。问哪种陪伴受欢迎。高计数不确立外向、不安全感或寻求认可，低计数不表示朋友更不可靠。

title.en: Try an ordinary, optional shared pause
title.zh: 试一次普通且可选的共同停顿

paragraphs.en: Offer a willing friend a short, unplanned pause: a chat, a quiet seat or a small shared game. Make it easy to decline or change the format. Afterwards, notice whether the time felt pleasant without needing a big outcome. This is feedback on one invitation, not proof of your popularity, humour or responsibility for keeping a group cheerful.
paragraphs.zh: 给愿意的朋友一个短短、没预设成果的停顿：聊聊、安静坐会或小游戏。让拒绝、换形式都容易，再看没有大成果时是否仍愉快。这只反馈一次邀请，不证明人气、幽默，也不要求负责全组开心。

title.en: A manageable start beside six other contributions

paragraphs.en: Harry tries the next action, Hermione checks the guide and Ron makes the time feel shared. Ginny chooses her role, Luna considers an unexpected idea and Hagrid attends to practical comfort. Neville’s selected angle gives an unfamiliar activity a manageable beginning. title.en: A small start is a choice, not a limit

A high count does not prove low confidence, vulnerability or slow learning, and a lower count does not mean that you cannot encourage a beginner.

title.en: Try a deliberately small first round

Notice what made the entry manageable rather than comparing yourself with an experienced person. The exercise concerns the starting arrangement, not a measure of potential or a prescription to keep pushing through difficulty.

Imagination can be enjoyed while clearly distinguishing an invented idea from evidence about the world.

title.en: The unexplained mark in the picture

The group can enjoy exploring it without claiming it is the author’s intended answer. If the game later needs a definite rule, you can agree one explicitly rather than treating the imaginative possibility as an established fact.

paragraphs.en: Harry starts a trial, Hermione checks the source and Ron offers companionship. Ginny chooses her part, Neville creates a manageable entry and Hagrid makes the welcome practical. Different contributions can coexist without ranking imagination, intelligence or open-mindedness, and an equal count does not establish a hidden or mystical identity.

title.en: Keep curiosity separate from certainty
title.zh: 把好奇和肯定分开

paragraphs.en: An unexpected thought does not have to be true to be useful in a fictional game. title.en: Try two clearly fictional possibilities

title.en: Hagrid’s limited fan reading
title.zh: 海格的有限同人读法

paragraphs.en: Hagrid is Hogwarts’ gamekeeper and a teacher of magical creatures, and he welcomes Harry into the magical world. This edition takes only an ordinary angle of helping newcomers find a comfortable way in. It does not infer appearance, physical size, animal-care skill or a particular family role. Your choices cannot assign his magical creatures, dramatic risks or responsibilities to your life.
paragraphs.zh: 海格是霍格沃茨猎场看守和神奇动物教师，带哈利进入魔法世界。本版只取帮新人舒服加入的普通角度，不推断外貌、体型、动物照料技能或家庭角色。选择不能把神奇生物、戏剧风险或责任放进你的生活。

title.en: A newcomer without the right materials
title.zh: 没带齐材料的新成员

paragraphs.en: Someone arrives at a fan club without supplies or a clear picture of the plan. You show what can be borrowed, where to sit and which activities are optional. Ask what would make joining comfortable rather than deciding for them. A practical welcome can be small; you do not have to provide every material, solve every difficulty or act as a permanent host.
paragraphs.zh: 有人来同人社团，没用品，也不清楚安排。你指可借物、座位和可选活动，问怎样舒服加入，不替人决定。实际欢迎可以很小；不必提供全部材料、解决全部困难，也不必永久当东道主。

title.en: Welcome beside six other contributions
title.zh: 欢迎与另外六种贡献

paragraphs.en: Harry gets a trial moving, Hermione checks the reference and Ron offers easy company. Ginny chooses her role, Neville makes the start manageable and Luna suggests an unusual possibility. Hagrid’s selected angle attends to the people and materials needed to join. None of the counts ranks kindness, care or responsibility, and a tie keeps the different full guides available rather than choosing a better person.
paragraphs.zh: 哈利推动试玩，赫敏核参考，罗恩轻松陪伴；金妮选角色，纳威缩小开始，卢娜提意外可能。海格角度照顾加入所需的人与物。次数不排名善良、关心或责任；并列保留不同全文，不选更好的人。

title.en: A welcome also needs room to decline
title.zh: 欢迎也需要拒绝空间

paragraphs.en: A newcomer may prefer to watch, join later or leave. Make those choices straightforward and ask before offering personal attention. You may also need a limit on what you can provide. A high count cannot establish a nurturing personality, selflessness or a duty to care for everybody, and a lower count does not mean you are unwelcoming or unkind.
paragraphs.zh: 新人可想看、晚些加入或离开。让选择简单，提供特别关注前先问，也可限制自己能提供多少。高计数不确立照顾型人格、无私或照顾所有人的义务，低计数不表示不欢迎或不善良。

title.en: Try a clear optional welcome
title.zh: 试一个清楚且可选的欢迎

paragraphs.en: For one small club activity, explain where useful materials are, what will happen next and how someone can join or skip. Ask a willing newcomer which part was actually helpful. Notice the welcome’s usability rather than how much you gave. This is feedback on an arrangement, not an assessment of hospitality, animal handling, parenting or suitability for a caring profession.
paragraphs.zh: 一次小社团活动，说清用品在哪、下一步是什么、如何加入或跳过。问愿反馈的新人，哪部分真有用；看欢迎好不好用，不只看付出多不多。这是安排反馈，不评接待、动物处理、养育或照顾类职业适配。
